description: Check a brand name against EU + UK trademark registers via TMview (EUIPO-operated, offices EM + GB). Read-only. Returns JSON with the EU/UK hits scored the same way as screen_trademark, plus the classes used. Use AFTER screen_trademark when you also sell in the EU/UK; the US screen is unaffected if TMview is down. BEST-EFFORT: TMview has no published API and resets connections from plain HTTP clients — when it will not answer, this returns { checked: false, reason } with a manual link instead of failing. A clear EU/UK result is a signal, not clearance.

classes.description: Nice classes (1-45) if known; otherwise inferred from goodsDescription

goodsDescription.description: What you sell — used to infer classes for the class-relatedness scoring

name: check_global_marks
